name: Kenco LIXIL Americas DC - Groveport OH

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed: 3099 Rohr Road, Groveport OH 43125 - the ~906,000 SF LIXIL Americas distribution center managed by Kenco (BusinessWire/Kenco announcement May 2024). Roster ROOFTOP coords pin the NW corner of the building; verified on satellite + Street View. The DC is a two-building tan-roofed complex in the Rickenbacker/Groveport logistics hub; the roster coordinate sits on the west building.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open access driveways off Rohr Road - no barrier arm, no gate, no guard booth. Street View (capture 2024-08) shows wide open paved entrance drives. Drive aisles between the two buildings are open as well.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth observed at any property entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - no truck gate present, so remote check-in does not apply.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building - continuous dock banks on BOTH long faces (SW and NE), trailers backed in on both. Shipping and receiving from physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large trailer drop yards along both dock faces and in the central aisle between the two buildings, with 70+ trailers parked.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock building ~370 m long with dock doors on both long faces; combined count well into the 50+ band. dockDoorCount ~90 is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The LIXIL Americas DC is a two-building tan-roofed complex; both buildings form the ~906,000 SF facility. Marked true at campus level.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide aprons and drives leave ample room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Groveport is a southeast Columbus suburb inside the Columbus OH metro / Rickenbacker logistics hub - dense industrial fabric. Urban.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: False - a cellular tower stands adjacent to the site on Rohr Road; coverage is strong.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.confidence: High - facility positively confirmed by address and the May 2024 LIXIL/Kenco announcement; ROOFTOP-accurate coords verified on current imagery.
